videos.t: X525 Flight Video and Characteristics of Multirotors - RclifeOn
videos.desc:
This quadcopter is amazing! Powerful, maneuverable, long flight time, easy programing and stable. This is everything you have ever want in a quad, with a 10-15 minute flight time and enough power to lift small dslr cameras, you can literally do anything!

After a couple of months of cloudy and snowy weather it finally arrived a nice sunny day to shoot my video. This video takes place in Sweden and are my third video. I mainly made this video for my search of summer jobs and as always, for fun!

videos.t: Shooting Fireworks From RC Airplane - RcLifeOn
videos.desc:
I came up with the idea of remotely firing fireworks from my rc airplanes this new year's eve. I decided to search around the net and noticed a couple of successful attempts but they were all quite complicated. 

The design of having a small resistor igniting the fuse is simple, reliable and cheap. Thanks David Windestål! I manage to fire 9 out of 10 fireworks everytime. And reloading just takes a couple of seconds! 

The Bixler can definitely handle the extra weight without any problems at all. Even tough 10 triple A batteries might not be the most efficient it's inexpensive and easy to use.

videos.t: RC F-18 Jet Flying Fast and Slow
videos.desc:
This plane is a beast! It flies slow, fast and stable at all time! This is one of my favourites, with the F-22 V2 from RCPowers. Thanks Dave and Scott for the gorgeous airplanes you guys design. 

RCPowers F18 V2 is powered by the Super Mega Jet from Grayson Hobby, it gives me unlimited vertical performance! I am using a 2200 Mah 3s and a 50 Amp speed controller, and 4 servos (elevator and aileron). It gives me the oppurtunity to have 4x4 controll setup, that will keep me stable at all time and gives me great elevator controll. 

It's 1.5 meters in lenght and has a wingspan of almost 1 meter.
